Tests for {@link IndexedCollection}, covering both unique and non-unique index modes.

The key transformer used throughout is {@link IntegerTransformer}, which parses each String element as an Integer key. Tests verify that elements can be looked up by key, that duplicates are rejected in unique-index mode, and that {@link IndexedCollection#reindex()} resynchronises the index after external modifications to the underlying collection.
Converts a numeric String element to its Integer key for index lookups. For example, the element "42" maps to the key 42.
Wraps the given collection in a non-unique IndexedCollection.
Wraps the given collection in a unique IndexedCollection (duplicates throw).
Returns an empty unique-index collection for tests that need uniqueness enforcement.
Use a typed variable directly so key-based lookup via get() needs no cast.
Modify the underlying collection directly, bypassing IndexedCollection. The index is now stale: lookups return null because no keys were registered.
After reindex(), the index is rebuilt from the current collection contents.
